featuredFeature.name: Magic Prospections
featuredFeature.headline: Find targeted prospects for your exact niche service
featuredFeature.description: Magic Prospections is Retainr's upcoming prospecting and lead generation tool for freelance developers and technical specialists. It is designed to help identify relevant companies, match them to your expertise, prepare outreach angles, and move promising replies into your Retainr client workflow.
bullets: Target prospects by niche, technology stack, business type, and service fit
Generate cold email angles for your specific niche expertise
Track outreach, replies, and follow-up status before a lead becomes a client
Move warm prospects into Retainr signup, onboarding, billing, and delivery
featuredFeature.note: Planned first for the Magic Prospections plan as a lead-generation layer for technical freelancers who want more qualified conversations.

faq.question: Will the portal use my brand?
faq.answer: Yes. Your branded portal can carry your logo, brand name, custom domain, and client-facing experience.

faq.question: Can I add unlimited clients and buyers?
faq.answer: Yes. Retainr is built for unlimited clients, buyers, and service relationships, with team structure based on your plan.

faq.question: Is it easy to add and sell services?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a niche service package, set payment details, publish the offer, and send clients directly to the right signup flow.

faq.question: Who owns the data, customers, and subscribers?
faq.answer: You do. Your client data, customers, orders, and subscribers belong to your business.

faq.question: Do you integrate with Zapier and Google Analytics?
faq.answer: Yes. Retainr includes webhook and API options so you can connect your creator stack and automate the work around delivery.
